title: Witch on the Holy Night Anime Film's Sequel Confrmed
content: The staff for the Witch on the Holy Night ( Mahōtsukai no Yoru ) anime film confirmed on Tuesday that it will receive a sequel. The staff also announced that the film has sold 301,630 tickets for 516,132,800 yen (about US$3.24 million) over its first four days.
author: ANN

title: All You Need Is Kill, Kaguya!, Grotesqqque, More Anime Confirmed Eligible for Oscars
content: The Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences announced the films eligible for consideration for the 99th Annual Academy Awards in the Animated Feature, International Feature, and Documentary Feature categories on Monday.
author: ANN

title: 'Mahoutsukai no Yoru' Sequel Anime Announced
content: The official X (formerly Twitter) account for the anime movie adaptation of Type-Moon 's Mahoutsukai no Yoru ( Witch on the Holy Night ) visual novel announced on Tuesday that a sequel anime is in production.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Getbackers Voice Comic Staff Apologizes for Generative AI Use in PR Video
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for the voice comic of Yūya Aoki and Rando Ayamine 's Getbackers manga apologized to fans for the use of generative AI in a promotional video last week, and the resulting misunderstanding, confusion, and worry among fans.
author: ANN

title: Manga Creator Tsukasa Sei Dies
content: Manga creator Tsukasa Sei died on November 17. Sei's official X (formerly Twitter ) account announced the death on November 20. Sei launched the Mukashi wa Yokatta (It Was Good Back Then) manga in Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ app in February 2023, and ended it in September of that year.

title: Witch on the Holy Night Film Expands 981 Cuts for ScreenX Release
content: The official website for the Witch on the Holy Night ( Mahōtsukai no Yoru ) anime film announced on Sunday that the film will begin playing in the premium formats ScreenX, Ultra 4DX, Dolby Cinema, 4DX, and MX4D in Japan this Friday, November 27.
author: ANN

title: 3 Anime to Watch If You Love Sword Art Online
content: It’s been more than six years since Sword Art Online released its second season, and the next installment is going to be its anticipated feature-length movie. However, the movie will only be released in 2028, and fans in the U.S. will have to wait even longer for its global premiere.
